what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Morocco in Italy: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 11960 Moroccan asylum seekers in Italy, 54.1% of all asylum seekers from Morocco.
Refugees from Morocco, a separate group, live mostly in France, Germany, Spain and Italy.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Morocco, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2024 and 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2010 at 20 asylum seekers.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Italy.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Italy only.
